417)sa 'dul gyi gar 'cham la nye bar mkho ba'i rnam bshad zin ris bzhugs so/418)srid pa gsum na 'gran gyi zla bral ba'i/ /rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs padma

tei:div.tei:p: 417) sa 'dul gyi gar 'cham la nye bar mkho ba'i rnam bshad zin ris bzhugs so/ 418) srid pa gsum na 'gran gyi zla bral ba'i// rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs padma sambha wa// yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i zhabs pad gang*// bdag sogs btsug gi rgyan du rtag par mchod// ༈ de la spyir rgyal ba thabs mkhas shing thugs rje bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i zla snang gdul bya'i yid mtshor 'grib med du 'char ba'i phrin las kyi sgo thabs dpag tu med pa'i nang nas ches rmad du byung ba'i nges gsang rdo rje'i theg pa dam pa'i gzhung lam la brten nas bdag dang gzhan gyi don 419) kun bde slag tu 'grub par byed pa smin byed kyi dbang dang grol byed kyi gdams pa gnyis kyi man ngag gi mchog dang thun mong gegs med du thob par byed pa las/ thog mar smin byed dbang bskur gyi gnasu sa rung bar bya ba dang*/ de las gzhan pa'i btsug lag khang dang rgyal po'i pho brang gnas gzhi sgrub khang la sogs bya bar 'dod pa'i gnas dang sa gzhi 'dul zhing byin gyis brlab par bya ba'i slad du sa'i cho ga tshul bzhin bgyi ba'i thabs rgyud sde chen po dag las ji ltar gsungs 420) pa ltar/ sa brtags/ bslang ba/ sbyang ba/ bzung ba/ bsrung ba rnams las/ 'dir bzung ba'i rim pa 'di nyid la yang blos bzung ba/ stangs stabs kyis bzung ba/ khro gar gyis bzung ba rnams las skabs 'dir stangs stabs dang khro gar gyis bzung bas sa gzhi 'dul bar byed pa ste/ ༈ de la ston pa rdo rje slob dpon ni dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi spyi dpal chen po he ru ka padma badzra dang rta mgrin dbang chen gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ de nyid kyang ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i rnam rol sku mdog phyag mtshan cha lugs kyi rnam pa gang la gang 'dul gyi tshul du snang ba dang*/ 'khor gyi rgyal thebs rnams kyang don dam stong nyid ye shes rnam pa dgu'i rang bzhin las rnam pa dpal chen po gtso mchog lha dgu'i ngo bo nyid de/

de ltar dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i phrin las kyi rnam rol gar dgu'i nyams kyis gdug pa la'adul ba'i rten 'brel ya mtshan gyi sprul bsgyur ngo 421)mtshar byin rlabs kyi bkod pa mngon sum du ston par byed pa yin pas/ 'di nyid la spyir byin rlabs zhi ba'i rol gar/ khrag 'thung khro bo'i 'gying gar/ pho nya rngams pa'i 'phrul gar la sogs kyi rnam grangs mang yang*/ 'dir ni dpal chen rol ba'-i stangs stabs du ma'i 'gying gar gyi sgo nas/ sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i gegs tshogs bskrad nas sa gzhi byin gyis rlobs par byed pa nyid de/ de lta bu dgos pa'i tshul yang*/ rgyud kyi rgyal po rdo rje bkod pa las/ rdo rje byin rlabs 'byung gnas dang*// gnas rnams shin tu brtan bya'i phyir// mchog gid sbyor ba dag pa yis// sa gzhi bzung zhing byin gyis brlabs// rdo rje drag po'i 'gying chen stabs// rgyun mi 'chad du byas nas ni/ khro bo drag po'i sngags zlos shing*// rdo rje khro bo'i stabs kyis bskor// zhes gsungs shing*/ de yang spyir gar gyi rigs dang stangs stabs kyi bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa lazhig rdo rje rtse mo la sogs pa'i rgyud sde rnams nas gsungs mod kyi/ ༈ dgongs don mdor bsdu na/ gar gyi ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba/ dgos ched phan yon gyi rim pa dang bzhi las/ ༈dang po ngo bo ni/ don dam stong nyid ka dag gi dbyings las 'gag med rang gsal gzugs sku'i cha rol gdul bya mos blo'i snang yul du ston pa kho na'o/ ༈ nges tshig ni/ ngo mtshar ba'i rnam 'gyur dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa'i phyir gar zhes bya ba ste/ nyams dgu po gang zhe na/ rig mdzod las/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ drag shul rgod dang 'jigs su rung*// snying rje rngams dang zhi ba ste// 'di rnams gar gyi nyams dgu'o/ zhes pa de dag kyang legs sbyar gyi skad dang sbyar na/

shriṅgā ra zhes bya ba sgeg pa'i nyams dang*/ de bzhin du bī ra ste dpa' ba'i nyams dang*/ bha yā na ka ste 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ ha sya ste rgod pa dang*/ adbhu ta ste rngams pa dang*/ ka ru ṇa ste snying rje dang*/ bhi bdapa ste mi sdug pa dang*/ rau dra ste drag shul dang*/ da yā ste rtse ba'am/ shā nta ste zhi ba'i nyams ste/ de ltar dgu po gcig car ram so so'i mtshan nyid kyi nyams dang ldan pa la gar zhes brjod pa'o/ ༈ dbye na spyir gar gyi rigs dang rnam grangs la brjod kyi mi langs shing*/ bye brag tu dkyil 'khor gyi lha so so stangs stabs dang phyag rgya gar gyi rnam 'gyur ni bsam gyis mi khyab mod kyi/ 'dir ni rgyal dbang padma sambha was mdzad pa'i gar 'cham 'phrul gyi pa ṭa nas ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul nyid las/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa chog gi stangs stabs kyi rim pa rnams khol du phyungs nas rgyud sde'i dgongs pa dang slob dpon gyi phyag bzhes dri ma med pa'i don gtan la phabs pa'i gar gyi rnam 424)grangs nyer gcig ste/ thog mar lam 'jug rdo rje'i 'gros chen gyis dal gyi sa gzhi bcags/ bskrad gzir zil gnon phyag rgyas log 'dren tshar bcad/ de nas rdo rje khyung gshog 'gros kyis steng gi lha rnams zil gyis gnon pa'i rim pa bzhi yod pa'i dang por phyag rgya 'byung po kun 'dul gyis gdug pa can gyi srog snying drang*/ gnyis pa bskrad gzir rdo rje bgegs 'dul gyis gdon tshogs zil gyis mnan/ gsum pa khyung chen gshog brgyangs zem 'gros kyis snang srid dbang du bsdud/ bzhi pa khyung gshog drag po dgu bskor gyis bdud sde chams la 'bebs pa ste/ de ltar khyung gshog 'gros bzhis steng gdon zil gyis mnan/ sna tshogs rdo rje 'gros chen gyi 'og gi klu gdon thams cad zil gyis gnon/ rdo rje khro ba'i 'gros kyi bar gyi mi dang mi min mtha' dag zil

425)gyis gnon pa ste/ de ltar zil gnon rnam pa gsum gyis sngon 'gro gtan la phab/ ༈ dngos gzhi stangs stabs rnam pa brgyad kyi phyogs mtshams kyi dregs pa can rnams 'dul bar byed pa ste/ shar du dri za'i gdon tshogs 'dul ba sa ga'i stangs stabs/ byang du gnod sbyin 'dul ba'i stangs stabs chen po/ shar lhor me lha 'dul ba 'gying gi stangs stabs/ lho nub tu srin po 'dul ba sa gnon gyi stangs stabs/ nub byang du rlung lha 'dul ba 'degs byed kyi stangs stabs/ byang shar du dgra gegs 'dul ba khros pa'i stangs stabs te/ dngos gzhi'i gar chen brgyad kyis sa gzhi brtul/ ༈ rjes la phyag chen rnam pa lnga'i 426) 'gros kyi sa gzhi byin gyis brlab cing rgyas gdab pa'i rim pa ni/ shar du rdo rje 'gros kyis sa gzhi byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ de bzhin du/ lhor rin chen 'gros/ nub tu padma'i 'gros/ byang du rgya gram 'gros/ dbus su 'khor lo'i 'gros kyis sa gzhi byin gyis brlab cing rgyas gdab pa'il rim pa ni/ shar du rdo rje 'gros kyis sa ste/ de ltar phyag mtshan lnga'i 'gros kyis sa gzhi byin gyis brlab/ rab tu gnas par byed pa nyid de/ mdor na 'di dag thams cad kyis sgrub gnas bkra shis shing byin 'chags par byed pa'i thabs zab dam pa nyid do/ ༈ da ni de dag gi phan yon dgos ched kyi rim pa ji ltar yod ce na/ rdo rje slob dpon phyogs mtshams kyi gtso brgyad dang bcas pa dpal chen rol ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug chen po'i brtul zhugs gsang ba'i spyod pa rmad du byung ba'i rol rtsal 427) 'di lta bus ni/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'gal rkyen sel zhing dngos grub kyi don bla na med pa 'grub par nus pa ste/ ༈ ji skad du/ rgyud chen rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa las/ e ma 'o ngo mtshar ya mchan che// dgyes par rol pa'i byin rlabs las// ji ltar dmigs pa de ltar 'grub// rgyud drug rtsad gcod ngo mtshar che// rgyud drug 'dus pa'i phong po la// ngan song gnas 'joms rdo rje'i stabs// ye shes thabs ldan snyan pa'i glu

/rmad byung gsang chen sgrog pa'i tshig /nyon mongs lnga'i sa gzhi la// rang byung ye shes lnga gsal bar// 'bar ba khrag 'thung sprin phung bzhin// khyu mchog lnga yi stabs kyis rol// dpa' bo che rngams gyad kyi stabs// mkha' gzhi dbyings kyi bde klong nas// tshom bu 'bum gyi cho 'phrul 'phro// 428) dgyes mchog rol ba'i phrin las las// rgyal ba kun dang mnyam par sbyor// gar mchog glog ltar 'gyu ba yi// rmad byung gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// 'phro 'du skar ltar 'khrug pa las// khams gsum bud shing thal bar rlog /ces pa dang*/ khro bo gyad kyi dor stabs kyis// tsham ngam chen po'i 'jur 'gros dang*// dpa' bo rdo rje rngams 'gros kyis// thabs chen bco brgyad stabs kyis sbyar// rnal 'byor rtsal rgyas so phrug rnams// rdo rje rtsal chen 'di sbyangs pas// ye shes lha tshogs gshegs pa'i rten// dngos grub 'byung ba'i rin po che// mthu stobs bkye ba'i thabs chen po// byin larlabs 'bebs pa'i dbang mchog 'dis// rgyal ba'i dngos grub man chod nas// mkha' 'gro'i rdzu 'phrul thams cad dang*// dregs pa'i sde tshogs ma rungs rnams// thams cad dbang du 'gyur nges na// dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos// 429) ces dang*/ gzhan yang*/ rgyal sras rig 'dzin bka' 'khor lo// rdo rje rgyal dbang chen po des// rig 'dzin pho mo'i mtshan mas btab// rnal 'byor chen po'i lus su spyod// 'jig rten spyod tshul thams cad ni// sgyu ma yin phyir shin tu yang*// 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod tshul dag /ji ltar 'byung ba de ltar spyad// e ma'o dur khrod gsang ba yi// rmad byung zhing khams dga' tshal 'dir// skal ldan dbang phyug rgyal ba'i sras// 'dus par tshugs pa'i rig 'dzin rnams// e ma'o dga' mchog bde chen grogs// thabs dang shes rab zung 'brel gyi// sprul pa'i gshog drug dgra rgyas pas// chos nyid rtsal gyi rlabs spar nas// chos dbyings mkha' la lding bar rigs// ces gsungs pa de lta ba'i 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i khyad chos rmad du byung ba 'di lta lta bus

430) gnas skabs su bar chad 'byung po'i 'tshe ba dang bral zhing*/ ma mo mkha' 'gro kun gyis rje dang gtso bor mthong nas phrin las bsgrub pa dang*/ rgyal ba rig 'dzin rnams kyis kyang sras dang spun du dgongs nas byin gyis rlobs par mdzad cing*/ myur du bla med byangs cub kyi go 'phang la sbyor ba'i nye rgyur byed pa la sogs kyi dgos ched dang phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa kho na lags so/ gar gyi rnam bshad 'id nyid dkyil 'khor gyi sa 'dul nam/bya ba'i skabs de nyid du/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi sgrub pa la zhugs pa'i tshogs rnams la 'chad par bya'o/ bkra shis/ 431)༈ sar chog gar gyi skabs su/ 1 thog mar lam zhugs rdo rje'i 'gros chen la/ rnga stabs ni nyis brdung dal bar bya zhing*/ lag gnyis rdor dril g.yas g.yon du brgyangs la/ rkang pa gcig gis gzhi bzung zhing*/ gcig gis g.yas g.yon du nom pa re dang dbus su gom pa 'dor ba rim can du bya'o/ 2 gnyis pa bgegs bskrad la rnga nyis brdung zhi drag can rim phab bya zhing*/ phyag rgya gdengs thabs kyi rnam 'gyur dang ldan pas thun gtor ro/ 3 gsum pa khyung gshog 'gros pa bzhi'i dang po phyag rgya 'byung po kun 'dus la/ rnga gsum brdung dal ba dang*/ phyag rdor dril dpung g.yas su bsnol ba sdig mdzub dang ldan pa lan gsum gsum gyi bar rkang pa g.yon labateg cing*/ yang de bzhin g.yas g.yon re mos su bya ba'o/ 4 bzhi pa bskrad 432)gzir la/ rnga gsum brdung sngar bzhin las/ rjes la gcig brdung ring ba nyis brtsegs dang*/ phyag rgya dkor nang nas dkrol bas sdig mdzub gdeng ba g.yas g.yon dbus dang gsum kar g.yas pa kho nas bya zhing*/ rkang pa re mos dang*/ tshig brdung gnyis kyi cham g.yas g.yon bsnol skor gyi phyag re dang*/ rkang pa yang de dang cha mthun par bya'o/ 5 lnga pa khyung gshog zom 'gros la rnga chom brdung dang*/ lag pa khyung gshog mtho bar brgyangs shing*/

rkang pa zem 'gros kyis stegs bu la bskor ba'o/ 6 drug pa khyung gshog drag po khro bcu dgu skor la/ rnga stabs ni thog mar nyis len/ bar du dgu brdung*/ mthar tshig brdung dal gnyis brtsegs bya zhing*/ yang sngar bzhin nyis len nas dbu labatsug pa dang*/ phyag rgya ni khyung gshog gi dbyibs ldan gyis/ rnga nyis len 433) gyi dang po la rkang pa g.yon gyi rting pa bkan zhing g.yas gzhi bzung*/ gnyis pa'i tshe rkang pa g.yas kyi rtse btsug pa dang*/ de nas dgu brdung gi dang po la g.yon phyogs su bskor/ gnyis pa la g.yon gyi rtse btsug gsum pa la de'i rting pa bkan/ bzhi pa la g.yas kyi rtse btsug lnga pa la de'i rting pa bkan/ drug pa la g.yon gyi rtse btsug bdun par g.yon nas g.yas phyogs su bskor/ brgyad pa la g.yas kyi rtse btsug dgu pa'i tshe g.yas 'gying*/ slar tshig brdung dang po la g.yon du 'gying*/ phyi ma la g.yas 'gying bya'o/ de nas bzhi brdung tshar gnyis pa la nub dang*/ gsum pa la byang dang*/ bzhi pa la lho'i rdor rwa dang*/ yang sbar bzhin shar du log pa'o/ brgyad pa rdo rje'i khro bo'i 'gros la/ rnga gsum brdung gsum brtsegs dang*/ bdun pa sna tshogs rdo rje 'gros la/ rnga bzhi brdung zhi drag can dang phyag rgya pad skor dang bcas pas/ thog mar shar nas dbus su blta bas shar gyi rdor rwa'i tshul bya rkang pa dor stabs re mos 435) bteg cing lag pa g.yas brkyangs bas sdig mdzub kyi rdo rje gdengs shing*/ g.yon snying khar sdig mdzub dril 'khrol dang*/ gsum brdung bar ma de nyid g.yas g.yon bsgyur zhing*/ gsum brdung phyi ma'i tshe pad kor bkrol bas sked pa ston pa dang*/ slar gong bzhin no/ 9) dngos gzhi stangs stabs brgyad kyi dang po sa ga'i stangs stabs la/ rnga gcig brdung dal ba la/ phyag rgya g.yas rdo rje gdengs shing g.yon dril ba dkur bsten te/ rnga lan gsum gyi bar du g.yas nas g.yon du bskor zhing*/

rkang pa re mos ya gcig gi rtse ba tsug cing gcig shos kyi gzhi bzung*/ yang lag g.yas dkur bsten zhing g.yon dril 'khrol gdengs pas g.yon nas g.yas su bskor tshul snga ma bzhin te re mos bya'o/ 10 lhor zlum po'i stangs stabs la rnga grangs ni chig brdung ring mo 435) gong ltar la/ dang po la/ rkang pa shugs 'gros kyis g.yas nas g.yon du bskor/ bar du 'gying stabs dang bcas pas g.yas kyi rtse btsug phyi ma la de'i rting pa bkan/ slar sngar bzhin g.yas g.yon brje ba'o/ 11 nub tu rol ba'i stangs stabs la rnga bzhi brdung zhi drag can dang phyag rgya pad dkor gyis mched lcam gnyis gnyis mdun rgyab re mos su sprad cing*/ rkang pa yang de dang mtshungs par 'jog bteg re mos su bya'o/ 12 byang du stangs stabs la rnga thog mar gsum brdung gsum la phyag rgya pad kor g.yas g.yon dbus gsum dang*/ de nas chid brdung dal ba gsum la 'gying stabs dang ldan pas g.yon phyogs su zur mchong lan gsum dang*/ mthar gsum brdung tshar gcig lag gnyis rked pa bsten gyis ldem ldem gsam bya'o/ 436)13) shar lhor 'gying tshul gyi stangs stabs la gcig brdung dal ba gsum gyi dang po la rkang lag gnyis kas g.yas gdengs dang*/ gnyis pa g.yon gdengs/ gsum pa phyag rgya de nyidu zur stabs su rngams 'gying che bar bya'o/ 14 lho nub tu sa gnon gyi stangs stabs la rnga gsum brdung 'bring po dang*/ rkang pa gshibs shing lag pa pad kor tshar re'i mthar sor mo bsnol ba'i kha 'og tu phyogs te gnon pa'i tshul du bya ba'i phyag rgya de nyid g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du re re bya'o/ 15 nub byang du 'degs byed kyi stangs stabs la/ gsum brdung gong ltar la rkang pa'i rting pa gnyis sprad cing lo ma btsug pa'i tshul gyis spus mo phyir bkyed la/ lag gnyis pad kor 'og nas yar 'degs pa'i tshul du bya'o/ 16 byang shar du khros stangs la rnga gsum

437) brdung bzhi brtsegs kyi dang por rngam 'gying sdig 'dzub g.yas brkum g.yon brkyang dang ldan pas g.yon mchong gsum/ gnyis par g.yas mchong gsum/ gsum par phyag rgya gnyis ka brgyangs te g.yas bskor 'phar tshul gsum/ bzhi pa la rang sar ldem sked bsten gyi tshul lan gsum 1$10002501$1000180 bya ba'o/ bar 'dir phyag rgya rdor dril bsnol ba spyi bor bzung la/ rkang 'khril tshul gyis rnga gcig brdung lan gsum song ba'i rjes la g.yas g.yon spo bar bya'o/ 17 de nas phyag mtshan lnga 'gros kyi dang por rdo rje rtse gcig 'gros ni/ rnga gsum brdung 'bring lapo la/ phyag rgya g.yas g.yon steng dang 'og tu stangs stabs dang ldan pas/ rkang pa dbus/ mdun/ rgyab gsum re mos 'jug pa'o/ 438) rdo rje rtse gsum/ 'gros ni rnga stabs de nyid las/ rkang pa'i rtse mo mdun rgyab g.yon g.yas dang gsum rgyab mdun gnyis kar g.yas pas 'jug cing*/ slar g.yon pas yang de bzhin no/ 18 rin chen 'gros ni/ rnga gsum brdung gsum brtsegs la/ phyag rgya pad kor phyi nas nang du g.yab pa'i tshul ltar dang*/ rkang pa mdun g.yon rgyab gsum du bzhag pas nor bu mig gsum pa'i tshul ste/ g.yas su yang de bzhin byas pa'i rjes la chig brdung ring ba gnyis la phyag rgya pad kor bsnol ma me ri'i tshul du bya'o/ 19 padma'i 'gros ni rnga gsum brdung bzhi brtsegs kyi dang po la shar du gom pa gsum gyi shar gyi pad 'dab kyi tshul du phyag rgya pad kor dang bcas pa dang*/ de bzhin du/ gnyis la lho'i pad 'dab/ gsum pa bya/ bzhi par phyi 'gros kyi nub kyi nub kyi pad 'dab bya zhing*/ de nas gcig brdung dal 439) ba gnyis kyis dbus su ze 'bru'i tshul dang*/ slar yang gsum brdung gnyis kyis g.yas g.yon du padma'i lo 'dab kyi phyag rgya bya ba'o/ 20 rgya gram gyi 'gros ni rnga gsum brdung bzhi brtsegs kyi dang po la shar du bltas te/

rkang g.yon bzhi bzung zhing g.yas pas g.yon/ g.yas/ dbus dang gsum du reg pa rdo rje'i tshul du phyag rgya gdengs stabs dang bcas pas bya/ gnyis pa la lhor rkang pa g.yon pa de bzhin dang*/ gsum par nub du g.yas pa dang*/ bzhi par byang du g.yon pas de ltar bya ba'o/ 21 'khor lo'i 'gros la/ rnga bzhi brdung dal ba dang*/ phyag rgya bsnol zhing rkang pa btegs 'gros kyis g.yas skor du 'gro ba dang*/ bzh-i brdung tshar gcig song tshe rkang pa btegs phyogs spo zhing g.yon laskor du 'gro ba de ltar re mos su bya ba'o/ mthar gar 'di'i gar 'cham stabs ni rus rgyan gyi gar 'cham spyi dang mthun pa nyid do/ gyi sdud 'gros khams gsum dbang sdud la rnga nyis brdung zhi drag can gnyis gnyis kyi mtshams su gsum brdung zhi drag can re dang spel ba nyid do/ de ltar 'di dag ni bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i gar 'cham 'phrul gyi pra ṭa las dkyil 'khor sa 'dul gyi gar rnams khol du phyungs nas gtan la phab pa'i rjed tho zin ris su bkod pa ste/ gtso bor phyag len mthong ba brgyud pa ji bzhin slob dpon las dngos su byin rlabs kyi bka' bab thob par ma byas na/ yi ge 'di gcig pus don 'grub par mi 'gyur bas de ltar shes par byos shig gar 'cham gyi rnam bshad mdor bsdus zin ris dang bcas pa 'di bzhin phyi rabs kyi don du yi ger 'khod pa gyis shig ces/ rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po mtshungs med rig 'dzin snying pos bka' stsal ba'i mthus/ sna tshogs rang grol gyis dud khrod padma 441) brtsegs pa'i gnas su bkod pa maṅga laṃ/ spyir yang rdo rje rtse mo sogs yo ga'i rgyud sde rnams las gsungs pa'i gar gyi rnam grangs nyis brgya lhag pa tsam dang*/ gsang sngags rnying lugs la yang*/ 'dus pa mdo dbang chen mo'i chog gi skabs su khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyi stangs stabs sogs dang*/ gzhan yang chos bka' so so las 'byung ba'i spyi dang bye brag gi gar 'cham mtha' yas par mchis pa thams cad gsang sngags zab mo'i spyod pa rmad du byung ba'i rtsal sbyong kho na yin phyir/

byed pa po yang bskyed rdzogs kyi gdengs ldan dag las gzhan gyis ni ma yin zhing*/ bya ba'i gnas yul kyang gsang sngags smin grol gyi chos 'khor bskor ba'i snod ldan dam tshig can gyi tshogs khang ma gtogs/ ding sang rnyed 'tshol mkhan po rnams kyis grong khyer srang mdor skye bo mgo bskor gyi 'cham bro byed pa 442) rnams dang mtshungs par byas chog pa ni ma yin pas de lta bu'i tshul yang go bar bya dgos so/ zhes phyi rabs kyi gang zag blo ldan rnams la 'doms pa lags/ maṅga laṃ bha wantu/
